answer.explanation: When someone calls or messages the help desk about a password reset, I always open a ticket first under Access > Password Reset so there's a record before I touch anything. Then I verify who they are by asking for their employee ID and the answer to their security question. If they pass, I check the directory to see if the account is just expired or actually locked. Expired accounts get the self-service reset link sent to their registered mobile. Locked accounts I unlock in the admin console first, then send the same link. I stay with them until they confirm they can log in with the new password, then close the ticket with a quick summary. If verification fails, I don't reset anything. They have to come to the desk in person with their badge, and I put the ticket on hold. If they miss the security question three times in one call, I also flag the account to Security. The whole thing usually takes under 10 minutes.

If the caller fails the security question three times during one call, I do not reset the password, I put the ticket on hold with the note that the ID was not verified, tell them to come to the desk in person with their badge, and flag the account to Security.
